title: Amber Knowledge Plan
description: Declarative plan describing high-signal architecture documentation and knowledge cards (structured knowledge base) for a repository. Amber's wiki tooling uses this to drive coverage analysis, proposals, and maintenance of stable project understanding.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for this plan file.

version.description: User-managed plan version (bump on meaningful changes).

scope.description: Glob patterns controlling what source is in/out of scope for knowledge plan analysis and synthesis.

template.description: High-level template or style for the knowledge base (e.g. 'architecture', 'domain-first').

notes.description: High-level distilled understanding of the repository (strong priors for the wiki/knowledge build). Each is a short, authoritative instruction to the generator.

documents.description: Desired knowledge documents. Each represents a stable, high-value page or section that should exist (or be proposed) under docs/wiki or docs/architecture.

knowledgeCards.description: Concise, high-signal knowledge units (cards). Agents and humans can consult these for rapid orientation. Derived from or aligned with knowledgePlan.notes and code facts.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the card (e.g. 'core-engine', 'governance-layers').

title.description: Human title for the document (becomes category).

parent.description: Optional parent (top-level when empty). One level nesting supported.

hints.description: Authoring or analysis hints — key areas, modules, or files to cover.

template.description: Optional per-document H2 section skeleton template name (overrides global knowledgePlan.template).

path.description: Suggested relative path under docs/wiki (optional override).
